# pip-audit allowlist — reviewed exceptions to the release audit's pip-audit gate.
#
# Read by scripts/pip-audit-gate.py, which is run by the "Python Security Scan"
# job of .github/workflows/pre-release-security-audit.yml. Publishing to PyPI
# (release.yml, publish.yml) needs that job to pass, so every line here is a
# vulnerability we have decided to ship with. Keep it short.
#
# One entry per line:
#
#     <VULN-ID>  # <package version(s)>: <why it is accepted>; review-by YYYY-MM-DD
#
# - <VULN-ID> is the ID pip-audit prints (PYSEC-…, CVE-…, GHSA-…). It is passed
#   to pip-audit as `--ignore-vuln <VULN-ID>`, which ignores that ID for EVERY
#   package version in the lock, so name the affected version(s) in the reason.
# - The reason and the review-by date are both required. The gate fails once a
#   review-by date has passed, so an exception cannot outlive its review.
# - Remove the entry as soon as a fixed version is locked.
GHSA-8pqf-f4m5-798g  # twisted 26.4.0 (CVE-2026-106454, PYSEC-2026-4304): ReDoS in the twisted.mail IMAP4 server wildcardToRegexp(); djust uses Twisted only through daphne for HTTP/WebSocket and never imports twisted.mail, so the code is unreachable; no fixed release exists yet; review-by 2026-11-15
CVE-2026-115778  # twisted 26.4.0 (GHSA-cwm5-jh59-mwxr): unbounded subnegotiation buffer DoS in the twisted.conch.telnet transport; djust reaches Twisted only through daphne's HTTP/WebSocket server and never imports twisted.conch, so the code is unreachable; remove when twisted 26.10.0 final is locked; review-by 2026-11-15
CVE-2026-115774  # twisted 26.4.0 (GHSA-2qrf-pqgx-qh9v): negative literal size DoS in the twisted.mail.imap4 server's SEARCH parsing; djust reaches Twisted only through daphne's HTTP/WebSocket server and never imports twisted.mail, so the code is unreachable; remove when twisted 26.10.0 final is locked; review-by 2026-11-15
CVE-2026-115775  # twisted 26.4.0 (GHSA-3476-c5c2-fr73): unbounded element tree DoS in the twisted.words.xish.domish XML stream; djust reaches Twisted only through daphne's HTTP/WebSocket server and never imports twisted.words, so the code is unreachable; remove when twisted 26.10.0 final is locked; review-by 2026-11-15
CVE-2026-115776  # twisted 26.4.0 (GHSA-53xc-49m8-p798): unbounded line buffer DoS in the twisted.words.protocols.irc server; djust reaches Twisted only through daphne's HTTP/WebSocket server and never imports twisted.words, so the code is unreachable; remove when twisted 26.10.0 final is locked; review-by 2026-11-15
